metadata.title: Identity-Based AI Attacks: SlashID CEO & Co-Founder Vincenzo Iozzo, Live at Nasdaq

content.text:
Watch the interview below, or Click HERE:
Tech Edge hosted a fireside chat on June 1 at Nasdaq MarketSite with Vincenzo Iozzo, Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder at SlashID. The in-person interview was joined by Editor-at-Large Jarrett Banks and they discussed why identity-based attacks have become a key cybersecurity risk, along with the importance of managing permissions to reduce breach risk and govern AI agents.
About Vincenzo Iozzo
Vincenzo Iozzo is the CEO and Co-Founder of SlashID, where he leads the development of an innovative platform for identity threat detection and prevention. A globally recognized cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur, Vincenzo is a two-time Pwn2Own winner who demonstrated the first public return-oriented programming exploit on an ARM processor against the iPhone 3GS and co-developed the BlackBerry OS exploit.
He co-authored the seminal iOS Hacker's Handbook and previously founded IperLane, a mobile security company acquired by CrowdStrike. At CrowdStrike he served as Senior Director, shipping Falcon for Mobile, sourcing and executing the acquisition of Preempt Security (now Falcon Identity Protection), and managing the Falcon Fund.
Vincenzo's speaking topics draw on his deep expertise in offensive security research, identity governance, mobile threat defense, and building high-impact cybersecurity companies. He has presented at Black Hat, Chaos Communication Congress, TedX, and the European Parliament among others.
About SlashID
SlashID is a cutting-edge identity security and governance platform that automates the detection and prevention of identity-based attacks before they become breaches.
By delivering a unified Identity Graph across human, non-human and AI identities in cloud, SaaS, and on-premises environments, SlashID provides 500+ built-in detections, real-time behavioral analysis, and one-click or automated remediation. Its sensor adds proactive protection against phishing, call center fraud, session hijacking, and shadow SaaS risks.
With seamless integrations and an AI assistant, SlashID empowers security teams to achieve identity threat detection and response (ITDR), call center fraud prevention, and accelerated identity governance with minimal manual effort.
